internal_sabotage.name: OEM Internal Sabotage & Hybrid Infrastructure Taxonomy

techniques.name: Flooding the Information Space
techniques.description: Overwhelming information channels with high-volume coordinated messaging or synthetic noise.

techniques.name: Inauthentic Accounts and Amplification
techniques.description: Deploying coordinated inauthentic accounts or botnets to artificially amplify narratives.

techniques.name: Cross-Platform Laundering
techniques.description: Moving narratives across fringe, state, and mainstream platforms to obscure origin.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Sending targeted messages to gain initial access or harvest credentials.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.description: Encrypting data or systems to disrupt availability of critical services.

techniques.name: Network Denial of Service
techniques.description: Degrading or blocking availability of targeted networks or public services.

techniques.name: Subsea Cable and Pipeline Tampering
techniques.description: Physical interference with subsea telecommunications cables, power interconnectors, or energy pipelines.

techniques.name: Rail and Logistics Signaling Disruption
techniques.description: Physical sabotage or unauthorized radio interference targeting railway signaling and logistics hubs.

techniques.name: Recruited Low-Tier Paid Saboteur (Single-Use Proxy)
techniques.description: Recruitment of non-intelligence local or criminal proxies via encrypted messaging for arson, vandalism, or reconnaissance.

techniques.name: Legacy Mass Bot Flooding
techniques.description: Deprecated umbrella ID split into specific amplification and flooding techniques.

deprecations.reason: Split into DISARM-T0084 (Inauthentic Accounts and Amplification) and DISARM-T0049 (Flooding the Information Space).

migrations.note: Map legacy mass bot flooding records to DISARM-T0084; review whether DISARM-T0049 also applies.
